snippet.title: Silent Noise : Prologue - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
SILENT NOISE: PROLOGUE Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer | MSP Games

“A man only loses when he loses by himself.”

The silence is finally broken. MSP Games and Lead Director Manas Vatsh present the first official look at the raw, unscripted gameplay of SILENT NOISE: PROLOGUE.

Step into the shoes of David, an 18-year-old trapped between the weight of financial ruin and the suffocating atmosphere of a facility that shouldn't exist. This isn't just a game; it's a descent into a fractured psyche.

TECHNICAL NOTE:
All cinematic sequences and gameplay footage shown in this trailer were captured directly In-Engine. What you see is the true visual fidelity and atmosphere of the MSP Games experience.

🎮 SUPPORT THE REVOLUTION:
Wishlist on Itch.io: https://msp-games.itch.io/silentnoise

Follow the Studio: https://msp-games.itch.io/

📅 THE ROAD AHEAD:
Free-to-Play Demo: Arriving 1June 2026.

Full Game Price: $6.50 (Exclusively on Itch.io)

🌐 JOIN THE COMMUNITY:
Discord: https://discord.gg/DgYcZVtDG

Instagram: @msp_games.in

Bluesky: mspgamesofficial.bsky.social

🛠️ PROJECT SPECS:

Platform: PC (Itch.io)

Lead Director / CEO: Manas Vatsh

Supporting Director: Daksh Yadav
